# SDL_image 2.8.12

Upstream: https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL_image/releases/tag/release-2.8.12

Source archive SHA-256: `393f5efb50536ec13ca4f4affb69cc9966d3c3f969e6c5e701faddf9f9785381`

PNG decoding uses the bundled stb_image backend; no libpng dependency.

Retained files are upstream sources, public headers, and license notices.
Platform projects, dependency bundles, examples, and tests are omitted.
